meta.name: verify-form-validation
meta.description: Check that a form actually rejects bad input: the error message renders, the submit button stays disabled, and no request goes out. Use when validation logic was written but never driven, when a "required" or pattern check looks right on screen but was never proven, or when a bug report says the form submitted invalid data anyway.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 驱动表单校验,确认错误提示出现、按钮禁用、非法请求不发
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果校验逻辑写好了却从没真正跑过一遍。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if validation logic was written but never actually exercised.

howto.what: 让 Claude 用 Reticle 驱动真实表单：填入非法值后核对错误提示是否为应用自身元素、提交按钮是否真被禁用、是否真的没有请求发出，再用合法值确认报错消失、按钮恢复可用。
howto.when: 当校验逻辑写好后从未真正被驱动、required 或 pattern 检查只在屏幕上看着对，或 bug 报告称表单提交了非法数据时触发。

say.text: 驱动这个表单填入非法值，确认错误提示、按钮禁用和没有请求发出
say.note: Reticle 会驱动真实表单核对这三点

say.text: 再用合法值填一遍，确认报错消失、提交按钮重新可用
say.note: 确认拒绝是有条件的，不是永久禁用

say.text: 如果表单只靠浏览器原生校验，直接告诉我，别用碰巧通过的断言
say.note: 避免把浏览器校验当成应用的校验

howto.what_en: Claude drives the real form: fills an invalid value, checks the error is the app's own, the submit button is truly disabled, and no request fired, then fills a valid value to confirm the error clears and submit re-enables.
howto.when_en: Triggers when validation logic was written but never driven, a required or pattern check only looks right on screen, or a bug report says the form submitted invalid data.

say_en.text: Fill the form with a bad value; check error, disabled submit, zero requests
say_en.note: Reticle drives the real form and checks all three points

say_en.text: Now fill a valid value and confirm the error clears and submit re-enables
say_en.note: Confirms the rejection is conditional, not permanent

say_en.text: If the form only relies on native browser validation, just say so
say_en.note: Avoids passing on the browser's native validation
